_meta.principle: Defines builder behavior and fallback policy; never defines syntax meaning.
_meta.changelog_1.3: Added node_classification_policy (Field/Constant/TestCase detection hints), call_resolution_policy (self-call, super-call), import_scope_policy (lazy import tracking), string_reference_policy (template/config string resolution).

node_classification_policy._comment: Hints for builders to classify nodes into specialized Core types (Field, Constant, TestCase). Classification is based on structural patterns, not semantic inference.
field_detection_patterns: assignment where RHS is a call to a known ORM field constructor (e.g. models.CharField, Column, @Column)
builder emits Field node instead of Variable when pattern matches
constant_detection_patterns: module-level assignment where LHS name is UPPER_CASE (Python convention)
class-level assignment where LHS name is UPPER_CASE
builder emits Constant node instead of Variable when pattern matches
test_detection_patterns: class inheriting from known test base (TestCase, TransactionTestCase, etc.)
function whose name starts with test_ in a file whose name starts with test_
builder emits TestCase node instead of Class/Function when pattern matches

call_resolution_policy._comment: Controls how builders resolve function/method calls that require context beyond simple name lookup.
call_resolution_policy.resolve_self_calls_note: When inside a class method, resolve self.X() to ClassName::X. Emit calls edge if target exists in registry.
call_resolution_policy.resolve_super_calls_note: Resolve super().X() to parent class method via extends edge. Emit calls edge if target found.
call_resolution_policy.resolve_class_instantiation_note: MyClass() → MyClass.__init__. Deferred — requires type tracking beyond current scope.

import_scope_policy._comment: Controls how builders handle imports at different scope levels.
import_scope_policy.track_lazy_imports_note: Imports inside function/method bodies should be emitted as imports edges with metadata lazy=true. This enables impact analysis to find function-scoped dependencies.

string_reference_policy._comment: Controls how builders handle string literals that reference other nodes (templates, configs, URLs).
string_reference_policy.resolve_string_references_note: Extract string arguments from known functions (render, get_template, template_name=) and match to Template nodes in registry. Emit renders_template edge if match found.
